San Diego Chargers. The franchise was an American football team based in San Diego, California, competing in the NFL from nineteen sixty-one to two thousand sixteen. The Chargers were established in nineteen sixty as a founding member of the American Football League, and joined the NFL after the AFL-NFL merger in nineteen seventy, representing a pivotal moment in professional football consolidation. Born from the defunct American Football League, they became one of the league's most dynamic offensive teams, particularly in the early two thousands when led by quarterback Philip Rivers. Despite their explosive play and passionate fan base, the franchise left San Diego for Los Angeles in two thousand seventeen, ending a fifty-six year chapter in the city's sports history.

The Chargers won their lone Super Bowl appearance in nineteen ninety-four, Super Bowl Twenty-Nine, though they lost to the San Francisco forty-niners, marking the franchise's greatest disappointment despite a roster of Hall-of-Fame talent. Built a dynasty in the early two thousands around quarterback Philip Rivers, winning multiple AFC West titles and reaching multiple playoffs despite rarely reaching the Super Bowl and frustrating a dedicated fan base. Philip Rivers defined the franchise from two thousand four to two thousand nineteen, holding numerous team records and leading multiple division-winning seasons while becoming a symbol of individual excellence without ultimate team success.

Known for explosive offenses featuring Drew Brees in the late nineteen nineties and early two thousands, setting franchise passing records before Brees left for New Orleans and pursued his own championship dreams. The team played in two home stadiums: the historic Qualcomm Stadium, shared with the San Diego Padres, and later the newer Dignity Health Sports Park, reflecting the team's evolution. The Chargers relocated to Los Angeles in two thousand seventeen after decades of contentious negotiations with the city, becoming a shared tenant with the Los Angeles Rams and leaving a loyal fanbase behind.
